authorization_context.sole_purpose: Determine whether ONE scientific axis (A_PROPOSAL_SUPPLY_RECALL vs C_PROPOSAL_CONTAMINATION) can be uniquely selected prospectively for H3. Do NOT train H3.

frozen_proposal_policy.note: Stage-4D contract; unchanged. A-only keeps all predicted proposals (incl FPs) and only ADDS GT-assisted ROIs for zero-proposal components.

scientific_question: Can the first H3 axis be uniquely selected between A_PROPOSAL_SUPPLY_RECALL_LIMITATION and C_PROPOSAL_CONTAMINATION_LIMITATION without changing both? Decisive test: if missing proposal supply is repaired while contamination is left untouched, does the frozen system recover the Tiny-recall signal required by Phase 14?

A_ONLY.label: GT_ASSISTED_MISSING_PROPOSAL_SUPPLY_COMPLETION__NON_DEPLOYABLE
A_ONLY.definition: For every GT component receiving NO matched predicted proposal under the frozen Stage-4D policy, add exactly ONE GT-derived diagnostic ROI using the frozen Oracle geometry convention (margin=0.20); KEEP every original predicted proposal including all background FPs; same refiner, regional preprocessing, fusion rule, segmentation threshold (0.50).
A_ONLY.purpose: Identify causal necessity of supply for the regional Tiny-recall signal.

C_ONLY.label: GT_ASSISTED_FALSE_POSITIVE_DECOMPOSITION__NON_DEPLOYABLE
C_ONLY.definition: Remove confirmed-background proposals (overlap no GT); proposal supply unchanged. Reuse metrics from the existing root-cause diagnostic (C-only Dice approx 0.6288, Tiny Recall approx 79.17%).

A_PLUS_C.label: GT_ASSISTED_SUPPLY_PLUS_FP_REMOVAL__UPPER_BOUND_ONLY
A_PLUS_C.definition: Combine missing-proposal supply completion + GT-confirmed FP removal. NON-DEPLOYABLE upper bound only; answers whether A+C jointly approach Oracle-regional potential. Not an H3 design.

priority_rule.A_PRIORITY: H3_DESIGN_ELIGIBLE__AXIS_PROPOSAL_SUPPLY_RECALL if A-only materially increases Tiny Recall over frozen PREDICTED (lift>=0.10); R_A>=0.50; C-only does NOT materially increase Tiny Recall.
priority_rule.C_PRIORITY: H3_DESIGN_ELIGIBLE__AXIS_PROPOSAL_CONTAMINATION_SUPPRESSION only if C-only corrects the dominant downstream failure AND A-only fails to restore meaningful Tiny Recall.
priority_rule.STILL_MIXED: H3_NOT_READY__TWO_AXES_JOINTLY_REQUIRED if both single axes individually repair their failures and neither can test a necessary causal bottleneck in isolation.
priority_rule.INSUFFICIENT: H3_NOT_READY__INSUFFICIENT_CAUSAL_SEPARATION if no rule is cleanly satisfied.
priority_rule.note: Do not invent another label post hoc. If eligible, name EXACTLY ONE axis.
